title: Collatz: finite triadic certificates and superpolynomial residual denominators
body:
## Current checkpoint — 23 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** This checkpoint attacks universal convergence certificates, the complete cycle denominator, and ordinary-source branching. It adds an all-word residual-degree improvement, a total Lean verifier, and two actual-component constructions. The universal successful-witness assertion and the final integer gcd are explicitly unresolved.

## 1. A total finite triadic convergence certificate

For the shortcut map and its exact parity-complement autoconjugacy Omega, the written argument proves pointwise:

    Omega(n) in Z[1/3]  iff  T^k(n)=1 for some k, for n>0.

A proposed dual a/3^r may have a signed numerator. The core/Std Lean implementation proves a strictly decreasing lexicographic rank: denominator exponent first, then the odd-run rank or signed integer energy 2x|a|+1_(a=1). The zero numerator is handled explicitly.

The executable stopClock terminates for every proposed candidate at ordinary value 1 or a parity mismatch. The formal theorem finite_valid_triadic_reaches_one consumes only the finite parity checks through that computed clock. It does not assume all-time validity.

[TriadicDual.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/TriadicDual.lean) · [Written bridge and precise missing existence assertion](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/TRIADIC_AUTOCONJUGACY_ATTACK.md)

The late refresh found concurrent work in PR178 at 4e204f54136c79cf8c9393b34e3330594f99ae0a proving the same criterion and signed rank, with a Mathlib all-time consumer and an explicit written height horizon. That overlap is credited. Our formal addition is the total core/Std stopping clock and finite-check consumer. No novelty priority is claimed for the equivalence. The 2-adic construction itself is a written literature interface, not a formalization in this module.

**Open:** constructing a successful triadic witness for every positive ordinary input.

## 2. Every primitive word forces superpolynomial residual denominator growth

For F=X^p−2^A, the full word polynomial Q, monic G=gcd(F,Q), and n=deg(F/G), the new elementary written proof gives, for every primitive word with p>=10:

    n > (log p)^2 / (72 log(2 log p)).

The finite-Fourier structure from PR185 yields an order-lcm constraint. Charging maximal prime powers once gives a totient budget; a central-binomial estimate converts it to the displayed bound. The degree theorem does not assume a positive cycle or a fixed word schema.

Combining this with PR185's separately source-qualified factor-gap theorem yields, uniformly over primitive positive words:

    For every fixed K>0, D_pol > p^K for all sufficiently large p.

Here D_pol=|F_0(3)| is the denominator after the complete polynomial gcd. This is BEFORE the final integer gcd: the actual reduced denominator is D_pol/gcd(D_pol,Q_0(3)). Integer-cycle exclusion would still require ruling out cancellation of all D_pol.

[Degree and denominator proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/SUPERPOLYNOMIAL_RESIDUAL_DENOMINATOR.md) · [Direct distinguished-gcd closing attempt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/DISTINGUISHED_GCD_CONTINUATION.md)

The companion checks the precise Grieve–Wang and Corvaja–Zannier interfaces. It proves a narrowly stated all-word encoding obstruction and reconstructs the carry group, without claiming a universal impossibility theorem for other Diophantine approaches. PR185's inherited continued-fraction certificate was not rerun.

## 3. An actual-component recurrent network and sibling transport cost

Conditional only on a hypothetical actual escaping component, a countable path-law mixture constructs an atomless law with positive mass at every ordinary vertex, a critical harmonic G, bounded G(n)/n, and finite sum G(n)/n^2. It needs no predecessor-density input or canonical-envelope identification.

The equal mixture of forward motion and the actual inverse kernel is null recurrent. The bounded physical coordinate has an exact signed drift; a finite weighted measure makes its conditional inverse moment average exactly 1/3. The auxiliary recurrence does not assert recurrence of deterministic Collatz.

[Recurrent network and drift](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/RECURRENT_ARITHMETIC_NETWORK.md)

For equal-depth transport through successive sibling cones, exact source separation and physical telescoping force total excess gap at least log2(N!)−O_p(N). A second core/Std Lean module proves the distinct-source core for arbitrary deterministic maps with the stated merger clocks. Unequal-depth and normalized weighted transports are not excluded.

[Sibling transport proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/SIBLING_CONE_TRANSPORT.md) · [Source-separation Lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/research/lean-global-closure-20261121/risk24/SiblingSourceSeparation.lean)

## Latest-source review and earlier checkpoints

The refresh covered metadata for all 145 PRs, then inspected the substantive late deltas in PR176 c82e3c1b..., PR178 4e204f54..., PR180 fcdcdbad..., and PR182 b78819e9.... The metadata and review files preserve full SHAs and exact paths. This is not a claim to have re-proved every branch.

The new real-boundary dimension and local cycle reconstruction results do not supply the missing integer-endpoint entropy transfer or numerical-gcd exclusion. The canonical boundary qualifications are not silently transferred to our constructed G.

The preceding Hardy inverse-tree checkpoint remains preserved. Its exact PR description, historical execution receipt and source pins are archived in [previous-pr-description.json](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/e5313208c09e5c47bb8592189975825842b19158/reports/lean-global-closure-20261121/nov23/risk24/previous-pr-description.json).
